account_login_identifiers_proof_check.name: account_login_identifiers_proof_check
account_login_identifiers_proof_check.value: ("account_login_identifiers"."kind"='primary' AND "account_login_identifiers"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("account_login_identifiers"."kind"<>'primary' AND "account_login_identifiers"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

ai_model_test_lease.name: ai_model_test_lease
ai_model_test_lease.value: ("ai_model_test_jobs"."status"='leased' AND "ai_model_test_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_model_test_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ai_model_test_jobs"."status"<>'leased' AND "ai_model_test_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "ai_model_test_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL)

auth_delivery_binding_check.name: auth_delivery_binding_check
auth_delivery_binding_check.value: ("auth_delivery_outbox"."kind"='otp' AND "auth_delivery_outbox"."challenge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_delivery_outbox"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("auth_delivery_outbox"."kind"='staff_activation' AND "auth_delivery_outbox"."challenge_id" IS NULL AND "auth_delivery_outbox"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_bank_receipts_state_fields.name: chk_bank_receipts_state_fields
chk_bank_receipts_state_fields.value:
(
        (
          "bank_receipts"."state" = 'Confirmed'
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "bank_receipts"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "bank_receipts"."state" = 'Rejected'
          AND "bank_receipts"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("bank_receipts"."rejection_reason")) > 0
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_by" IS NULL
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "bank_receipts"."state" IN ('Submitted', 'UnderReview')
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_by" IS NULL
          AND "bank_receipts"."confirmed_at" IS NULL
          AND "bank_receipts"."rejection_reason" IS NULL
        )
      )

chk_ian_recipient.name: chk_ian_recipient
chk_ian_recipient.value: "in_app_notifications"."profile_id" IS NOT NULL OR "in_app_notifications"."recipient_user_id" IS NOT NULL

chk_invoice_reminder_schedule_sent_at.name: chk_invoice_reminder_schedule_sent_at
chk_invoice_reminder_schedule_sent_at.value: ( (status = 'sent' AND sent_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'sent' AND sent_at IS NULL) )

generated.as: CASE WHEN adjustment_kind = 'credit' THEN -total_amount ELSE total_amount END

ck_invoices_adjustment_kind_matches_link.name: ck_invoices_adjustment_kind_matches_link
ck_invoices_adjustment_kind_matches_link.value:
(
        ("invoices"."adjustment_for_invoice_id" IS NULL) = ("invoices"."adjustment_kind" IS NULL)
        AND (
          "invoices"."adjustment_kind" IS NULL
          OR "invoices"."adjustment_kind" IN ('charge', 'credit')
        )
      )

notification_outbox_recipient_check.name: notification_outbox_recipient_check
notification_outbox_recipient_check.value: "notification_outbox"."profile_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notification_outbox"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

otp_challenge_purpose_binding.name: otp_challenge_purpose_binding
otp_challenge_purpose_binding.value:
"otp_challenges"."purpose" = 'legacy_invalid'
    OR ("otp_challenges"."purpose" = 'registration' AND "otp_challenges"."user_id" IS NULL
        AND "otp_challenges"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "otp_challenges"."tos_version_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("otp_challenges"."purpose" IN ('login','password_reset','change_username','add_email','add_mobile')
        AND "otp_challenges"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_wallet_tx_reversal_original.name: chk_wallet_tx_reversal_original
chk_wallet_tx_reversal_original.value: ("wallet_transactions"."type" = 'reversal' AND "wallet_transactions"."reverses_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("wallet_transactions"."type" <> 'reversal' AND "wallet_transactions"."reverses_transaction_id" IS NULL)
